Good to know

Common questions

Netflix is asking for a login or household code — what do I do?

Don't worry — this is normal on Netflix profiles. Just message us on WhatsApp and we will guide you or send the code.

Quick self-fix that works for many customers: on the sign-in screen choose Get Help → sign in with password instead of the email code option, using the details we sent you.

What are the CapCut Pro device rules?

CapCut Pro from Digicounts is a 1 device login only account — phone, tablet or laptop, but only one device.

Please take this seriously: if you try to log in on more than one device, CapCut detects the login attempts and the account can be locked, restricted or stopped (too many login attempts, account locked, access denied). In that case Digicounts will not be responsible and cannot fix or replace the account — by buying, you agree to use it on one device only.

So pick your main device first, and message us on WhatsApp before ever switching devices.

How is my subscription delivered?

Everything is delivered on WhatsApp, in the same chat where you ordered. After we verify your payment screenshot, we send your login details and stay in the chat until you are set up.

How do I pay?

Pay right here on the website: after you place your order, the payment step shows our FonePay QR and your total. Scan it with any banking app or wallet (FonePay) and pay the exact amount.

In the payment remarks, write only your full name. Then tap “Payment Done” and send us the screenshot on WhatsApp so we can match and deliver your order.

When can I reach support?

We are online every day, 10 AM – 10 PM (Nepal time). Login problem, code not coming, plan question — message us on WhatsApp in those hours and we will sort it out.

How many days is 1 month?

Our plans are counted in days: 1 month = 25–30 days of full access, depending on the plan. The exact validity is confirmed in your WhatsApp chat when you order.

Netflix says my TV is not part of the household / asks for a code — what now?

On the TV, choose Watch Temporarily, then Send Code, and message us on WhatsApp — we will give you the code.

If the login keeps looping: wait 30 minutes, reinstall the Netflix app, or try on mobile data — and always copy-paste the login details exactly as we sent them, with no extra spaces.

Can I change the Netflix password or profile settings?

Please don't — never change the password, profile PIN or profile settings, and don't add members. Changing them voids the replacement/warranty on your plan. If you need a change, message us first and we will help.

How many devices can I watch on at once?

Netflix 1 screen plans = 1 device at a time. The 5 Screens plan is made on your own Gmail, so the whole family can watch.

Prime Video: 1 device at a time, and a maximum of 2 logins per day — more than that voids replacement.

What should I write in the payment remarks?

Write only your full name — never the service or plan name. Wrong remarks need 12–24 hours of extra verification, and refunds are not possible during that verification.

How fast will I get my account?

Usually within minutes after we verify your payment screenshot, during our online hours — every day, 10 AM – 10 PM (Nepal time).

My plan is expiring — how do I renew?

Easy — just message us on WhatsApp before it expires and we will renew the same plan for you in minutes. No need to order again from the start.

Ready to watch?

Message us on WhatsApp, pay by FonePay, and start watching in 4K — usually within minutes.
